# Nandhini Tex — Handwoven Silk & Cotton Sarees

> Nandhini Tex is a curated online store for handwoven silk and cotton sarees, direct from Elampillai, Kanchipuram, and other Tamil Nadu weaving centres. Every saree is woven on traditional handlooms by master artisans.

## About

Nandhini Tex is a handloom-first saree brand based in Elampillai, Salem, Tamil Nadu, India. Founded to bring authentic Tamil Nadu handwoven textiles directly to customers across India, the store offers over 70 unique weaves ranging from ₹249 offer sarees to ₹35,000 grand bridal Kanchipuram silk sarees with pure gold zari. Every saree ships with an approximately 0.8 metre matching running blouse piece at no extra cost.

- **Legal name:** Nandhini Tex Handlooms

- **Payment:** UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, Cash on Delivery (COD with ₹40 surcharge)
- **Shipping:** Pan-India via Delhivery, DTDC, India Post. Free shipping above ₹999.
- **Returns:** 7-day returns on unused sarees with original tags intact.

## Fabric & Craftsmanship

- **Pure Mulberry Silk:** Used in all Kanchipuram sarees, sourced from Tamil Nadu silk farms. Silk Mark assured.
- **Real Gold Zari:** Pure gold-wrapped zari thread used in bridal and premium Kanchipuram borders and pallus.
- **Tested/Half-Fine Zari:** Used in soft silk and everyday sarees for durability at accessible prices.
- **Handloom Cotton:** Breathable, hand-spun cotton from Kanchipuram and Arani, woven on traditional pit looms.
- **Kuttu Join:** The authentic Kanchipuram technique where the body and pallu are woven separately and interlocked by hand — a hallmark of genuine Kanchipuram sarees.
- **Weave time:** 3–7 days per saree depending on complexity (bridal sarees take the longest).

## Every Saree Includes

- Approximately 0.8 metre matching running blouse piece (stitched into the saree, not a separate add-on).
- Silk Mark assurance on pure silk sarees.
- Fabric and zari details on the product page.
- Care instructions (dry clean only, store in muslin cloth, avoid direct sunlight).

## Shipping & Delivery

- **Coverage:** Pan-India, including all serviceable pincodes.
- **Couriers:** Delhivery, DTDC, India Post.
- **Free shipping:** On all orders above ₹999.
- **Standard shipping:** ₹60 on orders below ₹999.
- **COD:** Available across most serviceable pincodes with a ₹40 surcharge.
- **Delivery time:** 3–6 business days post-dispatch (in-stock items ship within 24–48 hours; made-to-order/bridal takes 3–7 weaving days).
- **Pincode check:** Available on every product detail page.

## Returns & Exchanges
